description: Expense Budget Tracker is an open-source personal finance and budgeting app for tracking expenses, planning budgets, and viewing financial dashboards with multi-currency support. It offers a managed cloud service as well as self-hosting options.
summary: Hosted integration surfaces on expense-budget-tracker.com include one HTTP Agent API at `https://api.expense-budget-tracker.com/v1/` using a long-lived ApiKey, plus one remote MCP server at `https://mcp.expense-budget-tracker.com/mcp` using OAuth-discovered MCP auth.
